mapper.update: update s_operation set quota_reservation_id=nullif(#{reservation},0),tts_reservation_known=true where turn_id=#{turn} and ordinal=#{ordinal} and operation_type='TTS' and tts_dispatch_state!='NONE' and tts_reservation_known=false

update s_operation set settlement_outcome=case when #{success} then 'SETTLE' when tts_dispatch_state='PREPARED' then 'RELEASE' else 'REVIEW' end, tts_dispatch_state=case when #{success} then 'SUCCEEDED' else 'FAILED' end, settlement_status='PENDING',settlement_next_at=utc_timestamp(3),settlement_attempts=0,settlement_error=null where turn_id=#{turn} and ordinal=#{ordinal} and operation_type='TTS' and tts_owner=#{owner} and not exists(select 1 from s_voice_task t where t.operation_id=s_operation.id) and ((#{success} and tts_dispatch_state='DISPATCHING') or (not #{success} and tts_dispatch_state in ('PREPARED','DISPATCHING')) or (#{success} and settlement_outcome='REVIEW' and tts_dispatch_state='FAILED'))

update s_operation set settlement_outcome=case when tts_dispatch_state='PREPARED' then 'RELEASE' else 'REVIEW' end, tts_dispatch_state='FAILED',settlement_status='PENDING',settlement_next_at=utc_timestamp(3), error_code='TTS_RECOVERY_REQUIRED' where tts_dispatch_state in ('PREPARED','DISPATCHING') and settlement_status='NONE' and not exists(select 1 from s_voice_task t where t.operation_id=s_operation.id) and (tts_owner != #{owner} or tts_deadline_at <= utc_timestamp(3)) order by tts_deadline_at,id limit #{limit}
mapper.select: select o.id,o.account_id accountId,s.application_id applicationId,o.turn_id turnId,o.ordinal, o.input_char_count inputChars,o.quota_reservation_id reservationId,o.tts_reservation_known reservationKnown,o.settlement_outcome outcome, o.settlement_attempts attempts from s_operation o join s_session s on s.id=o.session_id where o.settlement_status='PENDING' and o.settlement_next_at <= utc_timestamp(3) order by o.settlement_next_at,o.id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update s_operation set settlement_status='DONE',settlement_error=null,settlement_next_at=null where id=#{id} and settlement_status='PENDING' and settlement_outcome=#{outcome}
mapper.select: select id from s_operation where operation_type='TTS' and settlement_outcome is not null and (tts_owner != #{owner} or tts_deadline_at <= utc_timestamp(3)) and status != case settlement_outcome when 'SETTLE' then 'SUCCEEDED' when 'RELEASE' then 'CANCELLED' else 'UNKNOWN' end order by tts_deadline_at,id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update s_operation set settlement_attempts=settlement_attempts+1,settlement_error=#{code}, settlement_status=case when settlement_attempts >= 12 then 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' else 'PENDING' end, settlement_next_at=date_add(utc_timestamp(3),interval least(300,5 * pow(2,least(6,settlement_attempts))) second) where id=#{id} and settlement_status='PENDING' and settlement_outcome=#{outcome}
